content.text: Skip to main content PreviousNext Scorecards Official Scorecards | UFC 327: Procházka vs Ulberg See How The Judges Score Every Round Of Every Fight From UFC 327: Procházka vs Ulberg, Live From Kaseya Center In Miami, Florida On April 11, 2026 By UFC Staff Report • Apr. 12, 2026 The Octagon returned to Miami with one of the most stacked events of the year, capped off by a thrilling main event as Carlos Ulberg knocked out Jiří Procházka in the first round to become the new UFC light heavyweight champion. MORE: Main Card Results | Prelim Results Official Scorecards Charles Radtke vs Francisco Prado Official Result: Charles Radtke defeated Francisco Prado by unanimous decision (30-26, 30-26, 30-26) Kelvin Gastelum vs Vicente Luque Official Result: Vicente Luque defeated Kelvin Gastelum by submission (anaconda choke) at 4:08 of Round 1 Chris Padilla vs MarQuel Mederos Official Result: Chris Padilla and MarQuel Mederos fought to a majority draw (29-27, 28-28, 28-28) Tatiana Suarez vs Loopy Godinez Official Result: Tatiana Suarez defeated Loopy Godinez by submission (rear-naked choke) at 2:29 of Round 2 Mateusz Gamrot vs Esteban Ribovics Official Result: Mateusz Gamrot defeated Esteban Ribovics by submission (arm-triangle choke) at 4:19 of Round 2 Kevin Holland vs Randy Brown Official Result: Kevin Holland defeated Randy Brown by decision (30-27, 30-27, 30-27) Patricio Pitbull vs Aaron Pico Official Result: Aaron Pico defeated Patricio Pitbull by unanimous decision (30-27, 30-27, 29-28) Cub Swanson vs Nate Landwehr Official Result: Cub Swanson defeated Nate Landwehr by TKO (strikes) at 4:06 of Round 1 Dominick Reyes vs Johnny Walker Official Result: Dominick Reyes defeated Johnny Walker by split decision (29-28, 28-29, 29-28) Curtis Blaydes vs Josh Hokit Official Result: Josh Hokit defeated Curtis Blaydes by unanimous decision (29-28, 29-28, 29-28) Azamat Murzakanov vs Paulo Costa Official Result: Paulo Costa defeats Azamat Murzakanov via TKO (strikes) at 1:23 of Round 3 Main Event: Jiří Procházka vs Carlos Ulberg Official Result: Carlos Ulberg defeated Jiří Procházka by KO (left hook and punches) at 3:45 of Round 1 UFC 327: Procházka vs Ulberg took place live from Kaseya Center in Miami, Florida on April 11, 2026.
